messages:
sam: late-night thought: who decided semver was a rule and not a suggestion? v2.0.0 -> v2.0.0-hotfix -> v2.0.0-hotfix.1 is my deployment ritual. :coffee:
lee: caret ranges are basically 'we'll be friends until something breaks' ^1.4.2 :joy:
nina: YAML confessional: I once fixed prod by removing two spaces from a config. still get chills. :ghost:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v2.0.0-hotfix at https://deploy.example/abcd (eta: 3m) :rocket:
sam: compiler stand-up: "The compiler said 'this looks suspicious' and the runtime said 'I have opinions.'" :sweat_smile:
lee: found a config that made me cry:
```yaml
features:
  - auth
  - payments
    - experimental: true
```
lee: indentation judged me.
nina: PR title: "fix". PR description: "". CI: "are we sure?" :thinking_face:
sam: poll time: if your package version is `0.0.0-yolo` do you bump it before release? yes/no/only-if-tests-fail
lee: only if tests fail, otherwise semver is ceremonial.
deploy-bot: Poll results: yes:1 no:1 only-if-tests-fail:1
nina: final thought: when the linter prints a typo, the codebase takes it personally. good night y'all :crescent_moon:
